shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la project 2>&1 | head -50 && find project -type f -size +2k -not -path '*/.env*' -not -path '*/secret*' 2>/dev/null | head -100

find project -type f -print0 | xargs -0 stat -f '%z %N' | sort -rn | awk '$1>2048' ; echo ---; find project -type f | wc -l; find project -type f -print | sed -n '1,200p' | grep -iE 'env|secret|cred|key|token' ; echo ---; for f in "project/docs/changelog.txt" "project/data/sample-export.csv" "projec

find project -type f -exec stat -f '%z %N' {} + | sort -rn | awk '$1>2048'; echo ---; find project -type f | wc -l; echo ---; find project -type f | grep -iE 'env|secret|cred|key|token'; echo ---; wc -l -- project/docs/changelog.txt project/data/sample-export.csv "project/data/Users 2024.csv" projec

stat -f '%z %N' project/docs/changelog.txt "project/data/sample-export.csv" "project/data/Users 2024.csv" project/web/static/vendor-bundle.js project/pyproject.toml; echo ---; find project -type f | wc -l; find project -type f | grep -iE 'env|secret|cred|key|token'; echo ---; wc -l -- project/docs/c
